title: Compile a chunk
summary: How Lua source text becomes a function prototype. Lua has a **one-pass** compiler: there is no AST — the recursive-descent parser calls the code generator (`lcode.c`) as it recognises each construct. The path shown follows `local x = a + b`, the typical statement → expression → instruction route.

title: Compile source to a main closure
notes: Creates the main `LClosure` and its `Proto` and **anchors both on the Lua stack** (plus a scratch table the scanner uses to intern strings) so the GC cannot collect them mid-parse. Leaves the closure on the stack for `lua_load`. Called from `f_parser` inside a protected call: any syntax error is a `longjmp` out of the whole parse.

title: Initialise the lexer
notes: The first character was already consumed by `f_parser` to detect binary chunks, so it is passed in as `firstchar`. Also interns the `_ENV` name used for global access.

title: Compile the main function
notes: The main chunk is always a **vararg** function with exactly one upvalue, `_ENV`, marked as being in the enclosing stack (`instack = 1`, `idx = 0`) — `lua_load` later points it at the global table.

title: Begin a function scope
notes: Pushes a `FuncState` onto the `ls->fs` linked list (nested functions push their own) and opens the outermost block. `maxstacksize` starts at 2 because registers 0/1 are always valid.

title: Advance to next token
notes: Uses a one-token look-ahead buffer when `luaX_lookahead` filled it; otherwise scans. `lastline` is recorded first — it is the line number later attached to emitted instructions.

title: Scan one token
notes: Hand-written `switch` on the current character: skips whitespace and comments (including long `--[[ ]]` comments), reads numbers, strings and names; reserved words are recognised via a flag on their interned `TString`.

title: Parse a statement list
notes: Stops at a block-closing token (`end`, `else`, `elseif`, `until`, EOS). `return` must be the last statement, so the loop exits right after it.

title: Dispatch on statement keyword
notes: `enterlevel` guards C-stack depth for deeply nested code. After every statement `freereg` is reset to the number of active locals: temporaries never outlive a statement.

title: Declare local variables
notes: Locals become visible only **after** the initialisers are compiled (`adjustlocalvars` runs last), so `local x = x` reads the outer `x`. A `<const>` local whose value is a compile-time constant takes no register at all.

title: Parse expression by precedence
notes: Precedence climbing: parses an operand, then keeps consuming binary operators whose **left** priority exceeds `limit`, recursing with the operator's **right** priority (right < left makes `..` and `^` right-associative). Results are `expdesc` descriptors, not registers — code emission is deferred until the value's destination is known.

title: Parse an operand
notes: Literals only fill in the `expdesc` (`VKINT`, `VKFLT`, `VNIL`, …) — no instruction yet. Names, calls and indexing go through `suffixedexp`; `function` bodies recurse into a nested `FuncState`.

title: Generate code for a binary operator
notes: Tries **constant folding** first (`constfolding`: only numeric operands and only when safe — no division by zero, no NaN/-0 results). `and`/`or` merge jump lists instead of emitting arithmetic; arithmetic picks immediate/constant operand forms (`OP_ADDI`, `OP_ADDK`) when it can.

title: Emit an instruction
notes: Every emitted instruction funnels through here: grows `Proto.code`, then `savelineinfo` records a compact line delta (with absolute entries every `MAXIWTHABS` instructions) for error messages and debug hooks.

title: Finish a function
notes: Emits the implicit final `return`, closes the outer block (resolving pending `goto`s), runs `luaK_finish`, then shrinks every `Proto` array to its exact size and pops the `FuncState`.

title: Final pass over the bytecode
notes: The only post-pass in the compiler. Turns `OP_RETURN0/1` into the general `OP_RETURN` when the function has to close upvalues/to-be-closed variables or is vararg, sets the `k`/`C` flags on returns and tail calls, and retargets jumps-to-jumps to their final destination.

label: bind lexer to the input stream
starts with 'local'
notes: Other keywords go to `ifstat`, `whilestat`, `forstat`, `funcstat`, `retstat`, …; anything else is an assignment or call via `exprstat`.

label: right operand at higher priority
notes: Recursion with `priority[op].right`; returns the first operator it did not consume.
